title: Set localization of a left proper combinatorial model category without simplicial enrichment
statement:
Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention] and the model-category and combinatorial terminology of [lem-coef-combinatorial-localization-presentability]. Let $\mathcal N$ be a left proper combinatorial model category with functorial factorizations; left proper means that pushout along a cofibration preserves weak equivalences. Let $S$ be a small set of maps of $\mathcal N$. Write $\operatorname{Map}^h$ for homotopy function complexes in the original model, equivalently the mapping spaces in its homotopy coherent localization, as in [lem-coef-cosimplicial-frame-mapping]. A fibrant object $Z$ is $S$-local if $\operatorname{Map}^h(B,Z)\to\operatorname{Map}^h(A,Z)$ is an equivalence for every $(A\to B)\in S$. A map $u:X\to Y$ is an $S$-equivalence if $\operatorname{Map}^h(Y,Z)\to\operatorname{Map}^h(X,Z)$ is an equivalence for every fibrant $S$-local $Z$.

There is a left proper combinatorial model structure $L_S\mathcal N$ on the same category, with the original cofibrations, the $S$-equivalences as weak equivalences, and the original fibrant $S$-local objects as fibrant objects. Its two model factorizations can be chosen functorially, so it also has functorial fibrant replacement. The identity $\mathcal N\to L_S\mathcal N$ is left Quillen. For any model category $\mathcal T$ and Quillen adjunction $F:\mathcal N\rightleftarrows\mathcal T:G$, if the total left derived functor $LF$ carries every member of $S$ to an isomorphism in the homotopy category of $\mathcal T$, the same underlying adjunction is Quillen from $L_S\mathcal N$ to $\mathcal T$. Here the homotopy category is the ordinary localization at weak equivalences. No simplicial enrichment of $\mathcal N$ or $\mathcal T$ is assumed. A Quillen adjunction means that its left adjoint preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations; a trivial cofibration is a cofibration that is also a weak equivalence.
